description: Korean points-based residence visa (F-2-7) score under 법무부 고시 제2025-408호: age, education (STEM or double degree), Korean (TOPIK or KIIP level), annual income (needs minimum-wage proof), bonus points capped at 40 (ministry recommendation, KIIP level 5, Korean or top-ranked university degree, volunteering, Korean War participant country), penalties up to 70 (immigration fines, criminal fines); pass mark 80 and the gap. Eligibility and disqualification must be checked separately. Estimate only.

aboveMinimumWage.description: Income at least the minimum wage (default true)

income.description: Annual income from the income certificate (KRW)

korean.description: Higher of TOPIK level or KIIP stage (0-5)

stemOrDouble.description: STEM degree or two or more degrees

topUniDegree.description: Degree from a top-ranked world university (last 5 years)

warCountry.description: National of a Korean War participant country
